| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Scale** `scale` | 2 | 2 to 4 x | How many times larger the image becomes in each direction. A 400 x 300 image becomes 800 x 600 at scale 2. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 10 | 0 to 50 | The number of back-projection steps. With 0, the result is Resize with the bicubic method. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
